comparison.incumbent: Ren M7 link_voices_to_faces plus M3b speech_face_links
comparison.held_out: LC4931 nine labeled windows plus Apple 001 IMG_1808 and IMG_1811, scored once after threshold freeze; LCATL0011 remains unmeasured
comparison.labels: Round-3 A/B independent labels plus round-3 Anthropic Claude/Sonnet 5.5 blind tie-break on 20 windows; structured JSON contains 58 turns; prose report count conflicts and is not used

agent_label_agreement.speaker_attribution: A/B not estimable; C tie-break structured labels: 19 visible, 35 off-screen, 4 uncertain turns across 20 windows
agent_label_agreement.c_report_mismatch: C prose report says 79 turns (29 visible, 44 off-screen, 6 uncertain); structured JSON has 58 (19, 35, 4); metrics use structured JSON

quality_metrics.status: LR-ASD measured on 20 blind agent-labeled windows; threshold calibrated on LCATL0012 and frozen for 11 other LC4931/Apple 001 windows. Candidate remains research-only: held-out visible attribution 6/13, no multi-face sample, no aligned incumbent or ECAPA predictions.

adapter_validation.device_note: torch 2.8.0 MPS has no max_pool3d kernel; inference refuses without PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1

active_speaker_evaluation.labeler: Anthropic Claude/Sonnet 5.5 blind tie-break; agent labels, not gold truth

split.held_out: LC4931.MXF, 9 windows; Apple 001 IMG_1808.MOV and IMG_1811.MOV, one window each

threshold.method: maximize turn-level balanced accuracy over observed mean turn scores on LCATL0012 only; ties choose higher threshold

limitations: Haar detector with largest-then-nearest crop heuristic; not Ren face tracking.
No aligned incumbent M7/M3b or ECAPA predictions; comparison and contradiction rate not measured.
No multiple-face labeled windows; AUD-032 remains unmeasured.
Sparse obscured/noise strata do not support separate accuracy claims.
Apple held-out has only two windows.
C tie-break is agent adjudication, not gold truth.

excludes: outer interpreter startup before scheduler grant

upstream_only_metrics.source: publisher README; not measured by Ren

decision_basis: The frozen held-out turn evaluation attributes only 6/13 visible turns (46.2%), despite 13/14 off-screen abstentions; no multi-face sample or aligned incumbent/ECAPA comparison exists. Keep as a benchmark-only candidate and do not replace the baseline.

download_record.cleanup: AVA checkpoint deleted after labeled-window scoring; temporary checkout and predictions scheduled for removal after report update

integration.relation_shape: subject diarized voice entity; object visible person entity; visible camera source clock; temporal; candidate/inferred
integration.score_handling: raw_score stays in active_speaker_score evidence; relation confidence remains null
integration.clock_handling: measured Project Model time transform IDs are cited by time_alignment observations; joins above required max_error_ticks are refused
integration.runtime_adapter: library.tools.asd_lr (benchmark-only; explicit checkout path, MPS-with-CPU-fallback, no vendored code, no fetched weights)

watched_candidate_c3asd.status: no usable weights located as of 2026-10-16; paper-only (arXiv 2607.03018); no download made

evidence_reconciliation_study.source: FunCineForge IJCAI-26 paper plus speaker_diarization recipe README; literature only, nothing imported
evidence_reconciliation_study.pattern_adopted: ECAPA voice identity primary, ASD face scores auxiliary, disagreement as separate relation

speech_interval_union.method: Union reported turn intervals within each window; calculate intersection over union to avoid penalizing differing within-speech segmentation.

attribution.status: not estimable from independent A/B agreement
attribution.reason: A marked every turn association uncertain and supplied pause-grouped intervals; B segmented 48 turns. The boundary sets are not reliably pairable and uncertainty is not agreement with a specific association.

conditions.reason: A marked multi-face, obscured-face, and masking-noise absent but uncertain in every window.

third_labeler.discrepancy: Prose report totals conflict with structured JSON; evaluation uses structured JSON.

label_agreement.interpretation: A/B/C are agent labels and adjudication only; no human/gold truth is available.
